blocks.text: Proteins bare, pecheeda macromolecules hain jo tamam jaandaron mein wafir hain: jild, baal, haemoglobin (khoon ka surkh rang) aur muscles sab proteins hain. Jism mein in ke ahem kirdar hain, tissues banane se le kar cells aur aaza ke bohat se kaamon tak, aur kisi protein ki banawat ya kaam mein tabdeeli jism ko ghair maamooli rawaiya de sakti hai. Proteins ki mukammal hydrolysis se amino acids milte hain; taqreeban 20 mukhtalif amino acids mukhtalif tarteebon mein jur kar proteins ki bari variety banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Mukammal hydrolysis par proteins kya dete hain?

items: Proteins: amino acids (taqreeban 20 qismein) ke bare molecules, tamam jaandaron mein.
